test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 13 Feb 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: At 46 km/h and 36 km/h, two trains of equal length are travelling in the same direction on parallel lines. What is the length of each train if the quicker train passes the slower train in 36 seconds?
solution:
**Given:**

Speed of train 1 = 46 km/h

Speed of train 2 = 36 km/h

Time to overtake = 36 seconds

**Concept:**

Relative speed = Speed of train 1 - Speed of train 2

Distance = Speed × Time
